slot_note: Batch 3 re-root (architecture v2): new world, dataset, generator and shell; objective kept (anomaly detection); the weather-station world is closed
niche: a state utility commission's pipeline safety division auditing which operating areas a gas distribution company's 2027 service line replacement rider should fund, ranked on the service line failures the lines' own deterioration produced, when lines crossed by other parties' trenches crack weeks after the dig and the repair crews record the mechanism they find
analyst_test: A strong analyst who conforms the repair orders to service line failures, sets aside the excavation damage the crews recorded and divides each area's remaining failures by its active services ranks the fibre-build area among the four, because the cracks and coupling failures that surface weeks after other parties trench along a street carry the mechanism codes of deterioration.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is each operating area's deterioration-driven service line failure rate, the pipeline integrity engineer's replacement metric, once the failures that other parties' excavations induce are taken out by the excess failure rate on lines inside recent dig areas over the weeks after the dig, estimated across the whole system; with another field's nouns there is no trench settling under a buried line weeks after the locate ticket closes, so the task stops making sense.
layer1: 811 dig areas given as street address ranges, matched to service addresses
ticket revisions and remarks re-issued under suffixed numbers
one-call times in UTC against local repair dates
repair orders mixing main, service and meter-set leaks, with recheck orders for the same leak
active services rebuilt from install and retirement dates
area codes in the register against area names in the work system
state plane feet in the GIS against latitude and longitude in the ticket system
stakeholder_role: the commission's pipeline safety analyst preparing the staff audit of the rider's area selection

world.geography: United States, a fictional Midwestern state (the commission, the utility, its operating areas and contractors are fictional)
world.org_type: a state utility commission's pipeline safety division

driver: A unit's failures are read as its own deterioration, but some surface weeks after other parties work beside it and carry the mechanism codes of deterioration, so a same-day coincidence check clears the outside work; only the excess failure rate in the weeks after nearby work, estimated across every unit, separates the deterioration a replacement removes.
driver_concrete: Each operating area's service line failures are read net of those that other parties' trenches induced, the excess failure rate on lines inside a dig area over the weeks after its locate ticket estimated across the system, so the fibre-build area drops out of the four the 2027 rider funds.
stump: A competent solver sets aside the recorded excavation damage, divides each area's remaining service line failures by its active services and funds the four highest areas with the fibre-build area among them; the step that lands it there is reading the cracks and coupling failures that surface weeks after nearby digs as deterioration.

differentiation.task101: task101 keeps a funder's own top-ups out of a cold-spot baseline; here delayed failures on buried lines inside other parties' dig areas are taken out of a deterioration rate by the excess rate in the weeks after the dig
differentiation.task121: task121 v2 reads signed-out club-app customers; here the units are gas service lines and the separated failures surface weeks after outside trenching
differentiation.task464: task464 prices a feeder section's I2R loss on its own net flow with solar export; here the quantity is a service line failure rate net of excavation-induced failures
differentiation.task455: task455 separates establishment births from re-registrations in an employer register; here the separated records are buried-line failures induced by outside digging, found by their timing after nearby locate tickets
differentiation.task173: task173 forecasts the leaks a planned meter exchange will add on the services it visits (the utility's own work, carried forward); here failures already recorded are attributed, out of a deterioration ranking, to other parties' digs that preceded them by weeks, and the call is which areas a rider funds
differentiation.task181: task181 traces each operation's tray to a shared steriliser's loads; here no record links a failure to its cause and the separation is statistical, the excess failure rate after nearby digs across the system
differentiation.task303: task303 removes losses of supply that every sibling feeder records in the same minute; here the outside cause precedes the failures by weeks, so a same-time coincidence check finds nothing

lineage.niche: pricing a vineyard heat-day index cover off one weather station whose 1995 change from glass thermometers in a large wooden screen to an electronic probe in a small plastic shield matches the old readings on cool days and reads hot afternoons warmer, the old register kept to the half degree
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is the conversion between an old and a new measuring device sized at the value being converted, because the new device agrees with the old at ordinary values and departs only at high ones, so any single conversion, the average or one high-value offset, leaves a threshold count on the wrong basis and lets the changeover step pass into the fitted trend.
lineage.stump: A competent solver brings the glass era to the probe's basis with the comparison readings' mean difference (+0.13 C, +0.25 C on summer days), which moves no half-degree reading across 35.0 C or 40.0 C, so the 1995 step stays in the heat-day line and the quote is the raw record's premium, $567 a hectare against $525; a solver who sizes one hot-day offset moves the 34.5 C days but not the 39.0 C days ($542), or the 34.0 C days as well ($506).
lineage.fate: re-rooted 2026-11-01 at the Batch 3 queue reset (shipped 2026-10-12, no portal result; spent on paper 2026-10-21: the conversion was a documented transformation, readable by its clause or its parallel archive, and the ask layer measured over the bar)
